messages.description: Status bar and language server menu: a language server that safe mode does not start
Language server menu and log: why a language server is not started while the project is in safe mode
Language server menu: heading of the submenu of a language server that safe mode does not start, short enough for one menu row
Commit and Git log windows: shown in place of changes and history while the project is in safe mode
Version control window of a plugin provider: shown in place of working copies while the project is in safe mode
Run and Debug windows: why a process a plugin would start is not started while the project is in safe mode

en-US.desktop.trust.lspSafeMode: Safe mode does not start this language server, because it can run code from the project. It starts once you trust the project.
en-US.desktop.trust.gitSafeMode: Safe mode does not run Git, because the repository's configuration can name programs Git runs. Trust the project to see its changes and history.
en-US.desktop.trust.vcsSafeMode: Safe mode does not run version control, because the working copy's configuration can name programs it runs. Trust the project to use it.
en-US.desktop.trust.launchSafeMode: Safe mode does not start this process, because it can run code from the project. Trust the project to start it.
en-US.desktop.trust.lspSafeModeHeading: Starts once you trust the project

zh-CN.desktop.trust.lspSafeMode: 安全模式不启动此语言服务器，因为它可能运行项目中的代码。信任项目后才会启动。
zh-CN.desktop.trust.gitSafeMode: 安全模式不运行 Git，因为仓库配置可以指定 Git 要运行的程序。信任项目后才显示更改和历史。
zh-CN.desktop.trust.vcsSafeMode: 安全模式不运行版本控制，因为工作副本的配置可以指定要运行的程序。信任项目后即可使用。
zh-CN.desktop.trust.launchSafeMode: 安全模式不启动此进程，因为它可能运行项目中的代码。信任项目后即可启动。
